guia.what: A circular loading indicator for short waits with no known progress. It takes the text color (`currentColor`), so it adapts to wherever you put it.
whenUse: The operation is short and you don’t know how long it’ll take.
It has to fit in a small spot, like inside a button, next to a heading, or in a cell.
It’s enough to say “this is working,” with no further detail.
whenAvoid: A structure that will take up space later is loading → `skeleton`, which prevents layout shift.
It’s inline activity in the middle of text → `loading-dots`.
dos: Set the `aria-label` to what’s being waited on. It’s what the screen reader announces.
Put it where the result will appear, so the wait has a place.
donts: Don’t put up a full-screen spinner if you can draw the structure with `skeleton`.
Don’t leave a spinner running forever. If something fails, show the error.
